known_limitations: Retrieval: question generation can only cite pages retrieved for the ROOT question; transfer questions that cite a scenario page may be rejected for that reason, not because the model wrote a bad question (see retrieval_supplied_pages).
Lexical validators: paraphrased answer leaks and quote-of-a-correct-answer misconception claims are not detectable offline.
Gold labels were written by one author; AP-ACC2 good_transfer was corrected in V1.1.
n = 8 tasks: finds gross failures, does not estimate quality.
mode: DRY RUN (scripted; synthetic token counts and rates, not real usage)
